export_controls.text: The future of American innovation starts right here in the heart of the Gator Nation. 💙🧡 Proud to celebrate the launch of UF’s new HiPerGator the fastest AI supercomputer in higher education, in the country! A huge thanks to NVIDIA co-founder Chris Malacowsky for his continued generosity and visionary leadership. Chris is a shining example of the remarkable alumni that make the Gator Nation so exceptional. With this new supercomputer, Gators will be driving breakthroughs in computing, agriculture, medicine, and national security for generations to come. As always, it’s great to be a Florida Gator! 🐊

deepseek.reason: The statement celebrates a domestic AI supercomputer launch and does not discuss restrictions on overseas access.

export_controls.text: Great discussion with Nvidia co-founder Chris Malachowsky and his team along with the University of Florida on the importance of AI computing resources for academic research and AI education. With UF Provost Dr. Joe Glover representing Florida’s 3rd Congressional District, we highlighted how partnerships—like Nvidia’s work with UF—are helping expand AI opportunities in our state and beyond. With innovation, workforce development & national defense in mind, we are working on something big that is going to be transformational. Stay tuned! 🐊🇺🇸💪🏼

china_race_dynamics.text: Today, I joined my colleague, Chairman @RepPfluger, to discuss the Republican Study Committee’s new Task Force on AI and Emerging Technologies. As Chair, I’m laser-focused on harnessing American innovation to close technology gaps, secure our borders, and give law enforcement every advantage to keep our communities safe. We cannot allow adversaries like China to outpace us in the race for AI dominance. Our national security depends on it.
